scripts.setup:mac: cd frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && python3 -m venv venv && source venv/bin/activate && pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.setup:windows: cd frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && python -m venv venv && venv\Scripts\pip install cffi==1.17.1 && venv\Scripts\pip install cryptography==42.0.8 && venv\Scripts\pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.dev:mac: concurrently -n "backend,frontend" -c "green,blue" "cd backend && venv/bin/python -m uvicorn main:app --reload" "cd frontend && npm run dev"
scripts.dev:windows: concurrently -n "backend,frontend" -c "green,blue" "cd backend && venv\Scripts\python -m uvicorn main:app --reload" "cd frontend && npm run dev"
